literature_notes: FAM209B is a single-pass type I transmembrane protein (signal peptide 1–19, extracellular 20–59, TM 60–73, intracellular 74–171). The sole ledger entry (L1) reports a FLAG tag knocked in at the stop codon of the mouse Fam209 locus, placing the tag immediately after residue 171. Residue 171 is intracellular (topology landmarks: intracellular span 74–171), so this insertion is on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. No ledger line reports any tag, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon insertion, or domain-insertion in the extracellular span (residues 20–59) or at the mature N-terminus (after residue 19). Zero sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: FLAG tag inserted at the stop codon (C-terminus, residue 171) in mouse Fam209 knock-in mice; the C-terminus lies in the intracellular span (residues 74–171) and is not on the extracellular face.
